'''Loovi''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Outpost Senth]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he asked a fellow Republic citizen to strike a blow against the [[Hailstorm Brotherhood]].
